title: Publication Gate Decision
description: Schema for recording a publication gate decision for a specific material. Fail-closed: the recorded decision is derived from the canonical source-rights registry by source_category; the submission must supply provenance/reason/rule/version and the tool finalizes rights_status + timestamps. additionalProperties:false rejects any unknown field.

material_id.description: Unique identifier for the material being evaluated

rights_status.description: Rights status assessment, derived by the gate from source_category (not self-reported)

access_method.description: How the material was accessed (public URL, paywall, private account, etc.)

classification_level.description: Material classification level L0-L6 (derived from source_category, cross-checked against submission)

provenance_recorded.description: Whether provenance was recorded for this material (must be true to record)

permission_obtained.description: Whether explicit permission was obtained (for BLOCK decisions that were later resolved)

counsel_review_completed.description: Whether legal counsel review was completed

quotation_limit.description: Maximum allowed quotation length if CONDITIONAL_PASS (e.g., 'up_to_500_words', 'excerpt_only')

reason.description: Human-readable rationale for the gate decision (required for auditability)

rule_ref.description: Reference to the governing rule/registry entry that justifies the decision (required)

schema_version.description: Version of the gate/registry contract this decision was recorded under (required)

reviewer.description: Who made the gate decision (agent name, human reviewer, etc.)
